What it solves: Source: backlog root intake INTAKE-20260819-tool-miss-heal-wrapper-emits-invalid-bash.md (raised by the human operator ~19:55 local via screenshot of the QA session; filed by the coordinator, which hit the same failure twice itself), drained to backlog/archive/ in the same pass that minted this tic…
Approval context: Two decisions ride this ticket. (1) Re-enabling the hook: the operator disabled the PreToolUse registration on 2026-08-19 (3bac496ec) with the stated condition "Re-enable ONLY once the wrapper is parse-checked (bash -n) with fail-open to the untouched original"; this ticket treats meeting that cond…
